Alex — thanks for the profile. I've looped in Ben (sales lead) and Monica (solutions ops) and Karthik (capacity planning). Please find an initial proposal attached; highlights below.

Proposal highlights (baseline + burst guardrails):
- Baseline dedicated pool: 12x A100-80GB (guaranteed, 24/7) — sized to cover median production load plus 20% safety.
- Shoulder reserve: additional 6x A100-80GB kept warm for prewarm operations during scheduled peak windows.
- Burst policy: up to 3x baseline for short windows (max continuous 30 minutes, 2x extension allowed with credit burn). Burst is credit-accounted; credits accrue from underutilized shoulder time.
- Prewarm window: 5 minutes standard prewarm; emergency prewarm (2 minutes) available with prewarm credit at 2x rate.
- Autoscale cooldown: 10-minute up-scale cooldown; 30-minute down-scale grace to avoid oscillation on spiky workloads.
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile token latency target (with the selected model family) indicated in the attached PDF. Degradation fallback to a smaller quantized variant handled automatically after 2 minutes of sustained overload.

Commercial ask: committed monthly vGPU-hours equivalent to baseline (12 GPUs * 24 * 30 = 8640 GPU-hours/mo) at the proposed price in the PDF; shoulder/reserve usage billed as metered or pre-committed at your choice.

Next steps: 1) Confirm baseline and shoulder numbers or propose an alternate baseline; 2) Procurement to review pricing/contract language; 3) We can push a DocuSign link once terms are aligned.
